src/lib/hash.ts:export async function hashPassword(password: string): Promise<string> {
src/lib/hash.ts:  const msgUint8 = new TextEncoder().encode(password);
src/lib/hash.ts:  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgUint8);
src/lib/hash.ts:  const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
src/lib/hash.ts:  const hashHex = hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
src/lib/hash.ts:  return hashHex;
src/lib/hash.ts:}
